message: v1.8.14: feat(landing): editorial Convert-inspired landing page in Blackboarder Swiss Grid system (v1.8.14)
changelog: Landing Page Mobile Viewport Layout (mobile-web/index.html): Fixed mobile CSS Grid intrinsic width expansion (grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) on .stage-canvas and repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr)) on .mock-cal-grid with min-width: 0 across stage panes, weekday cells, status labels, and vault key boxes) so all 7 calendar columns and interactive stage tabs (Scan Flow, Marks & GPA, Phone & Vault) fit within narrow phone viewports (375px / 390px) without right-edge clipping or column distortion, simplified the mobile sticky header to a single clean row with full Install -> CTA, and tuned mobile typography, 2x2 step/utility grids, and card padding.
